texts.SamplePageMessage: A sample page for the GtfsRealtimeManagement module
texts.GtfsRealtimeManagement:010002: Lookup code must be zero or greater.
texts.GtfsRealtimeManagement:020003: At least one realtime feed URL is required.
texts.GtfsRealtimeManagement:020004: Realtime feed URL must be an absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL.
texts.GtfsRealtimeManagement:020005: The source has no URL for this realtime feed.
texts.GtfsRealtimeManagement:020006: An active realtime source is required for this organization.
texts.GtfsRealtimeManagement:020007: An active static GTFS feed is required before a realtime source can be activated.
texts.GtfsRealtimeManagement:020008: The {FeedType} feed does not reference any trip, route or stop of the active GTFS feed; it belongs to another dataset.
texts.GtfsRealtimeManagement:030001: Realtime feed response could not be decoded as GTFS-RT protobuf.
texts.GtfsRealtimeManagement:030002: Realtime feed version or incrementality is not supported.
texts.GtfsRealtimeManagement:040001: A static GTFS feed is required.
texts.GtfsRealtimeManagement:040002: A valid relationship lookup is required.
texts.GtfsRealtimeManagement:040004: GTFS trip, route and stop identifiers are required.
texts.GtfsRealtimeManagement:040007: Start time must use GTFS HH:MM:SS format.
